scientific_status: The sell rule was generated after reviewing all 525 parent charts and after the three-close entry refinement failed. This is consumed-history development, not independent confirmation.
single_incremental_question: Does recognizing failed acceptance at the frozen supply-event high, rather than waiting for failure below the event low, reduce false-reassertion losses while preserving durable H120 winners?
entry_rule: Use every exact completed parent entry without delay or reselection.

exit_rule.failure_observation: After entry, two consecutive PIT-valid completed closes strictly below the frozen supply-event high schedule a failure exit.
exit_rule.failure_execution: Exit at the next legally sellable open after the second below-high close; never inside the signal bar.
exit_rule.time_exit: Otherwise first legally sellable open at or after 120 market sessions from the unchanged parent entry.

staged_evaluation.stage_1: Apply only the frozen exit lifecycle and record completed decisions without return aggregation.
staged_evaluation.breadth_gate: More than 50 completed trades in each of 2018, 2019, and 2020.
staged_evaluation.stage_2: If and only if the breadth gate passes, run one development return aggregation.
annual_return_gates: mean net return greater than 4% in every development signal year
median net return greater than 0% in every development signal year
